description: a cylinder of radius 4 capped at height 6 by the sphere of radius 8 through its rim, the cap converted to its exact rational B-spline and sewn back, written by tools/oracle/occt_nurbs_blend.py: the rim, a circle between the NURBS cap and the cylinder meeting at 60°, filleted at r 0.5. A NURBS face against a cylinder has no closed form, so the blend is a walked ring (ADR-0062): closed, its seam the ball's arc at the rim's vertex (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 5b). Arris' blend holds the ball at r from both faces to 9e-9 at 451 samples; Open CASCADE's misses it by 1.2e-7 at the median and 9.9e-7 at the 90th percentile, so its measures lie 2.5e-9 relative from Arris' STEP read back, and agree with it to 3e-12 when it is asked to approximate to 1e-8. The measure tolerances cover that miss (ADR-0062, a walked fixture)

analytic.occt_step_unread: Open CASCADE's blend of the NURBS cap against the cylinder is a B-spline surface walked round the rim; Arris's reader had not finished its file after 11 minutes, which measures the reader on the walked surface, not the blend: regression/nurbs-cap-cylinder-rim-fillet-occt-step holds that reading
